texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Why do you want to:
Your posting says the FDE writes the glue, not the core product - that is literally my daily work. I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) and ship agent systems end to end: MCP connectors, integration scripts, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, CRM automation, evals. Debugging live agents against real systems (ERPs, portals, spreadsheets, email, custom tools) is what my work has looked like since 2023.

The customer-facing half is my native ground: 15+ years founder/BD, 10,000+ founder calls, enterprise advisory for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines, and government/bank relations across SE Asia - adversarial, compliance-heavy environments where you have to earn the right to push back. I own outcomes end to end and I like the messy middle between AI, process, and customer.

I am an EU citizen based in Lisbon, and frequent travel to customer sites is fine.
texts.What is one area of your life:
Running my agent fleet in public with measured accountability. I did not just build a multi-machine Claude fleet - I published the evals: in recorded runs, 0/17 high-risk (Tier-2) actions slipped past the human approval gate, and failure modes are documented publicly in FAILURE-MODES.md. Holding infrastructure to that standard - reproducible demos, published failure modes, 100+ automation routines that have to survive real days, not demos - is where I push for excellence.

The older example: an 11-year deal-flow machine at my incubator - 10,000+ founder calls and 2,000+ institutional-investor calls, run on a CRM I wrote myself, with up to 30 operators working in it daily.
texts.Is there anything else you would like us: EU citizen (Poland) based in Lisbon, Portugal - no visa needed for an EU role; I also hold an active US O-1. Available immediately. Public proof of work: https://tonydzi.github.io/ and https://github.com/tonydzi (110 public repos; flagships: claw-consensus, verbatim-citation-gate).
